description: Use this skill when someone wants to add a subscription or one-time purchase to an existing website — the server creates a SolvaPay checkout session, the user is redirected to SolvaPay's hosted payment page, then lands back on the site with access unlocked. Also use for wiring the return URL, building a subscribe/upgrade button, or giving paying customers a link to manage or cancel their subscription via the hosted portal. Primarily for Next.js; plain React (no server framework) is partially supported. Do not use for embedding plan cards or billing UI into a dashboard, processing webhooks or metering API usage, Lovable or Vite+Supabase setups, or wiring MCP tool paywalls.
